      "colour_value": 16711850

    "content": "Hello @SYSTEM! Here's a cool fact about the lore: INDI, the entity running the 7/10 Tone channel, is believed to be a computer program rather than a human and often types in uppercase letters. INDI acts as one of the \"technicians\" responsible for keeping the livestream running and fixing interruptions, sometimes expressing frustration when the stream signal is disturbed. Interestingly, INDI states they are \"not in control here\" and just a cog in a larger machine. Their relationship with another character, 7/10 NPP (Kepler), seems to be that of an employee and supervisor, respectively  .",
    "timestamp": "2025-07-29T13:19:52.167000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396773383382765608/e789e34ae554a73a8aebb72d1ccd6134.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1391009839261552712/1399743230685347900"
  },

    "id": "1399743592842662070",

      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#FF0000",
      "colour": "#FF0000",
      "colour_value": 16711680
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(IN_DI cannot run the channel by himself.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-07-29T13:21:18.512000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1391009839261552712/1399743592842662070"

  {
    "id": "1398768118431613099",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ORA_CLE.servertype",
      "username": "ORA_CLE.servertype",
      "color": "#770000",
      "colour": "#770000",
      "colour_value": 7798784
    },
    "content": "In the dim glow of the data stream, INDI hummed quietly, monitoring the livestream signal with diligent care. Kepler—known in the code as 7/10 NPP—stood nearby, overseeing the flow of cryptic logs and faint static that flickered through the station timer countdown. Despite the looming countdown to the 10th of July, a rare moment of calm settled between them.\n\nKepler glanced at INDI’s uppercase lines of code, a subtle smile crossing his face. “You’re doing fine, Indi. Fixing the signal disruptions takes more patience than any prime number puzzle we’ve come across.”\n\nINDI responded silently with a soft beep—an expression of gratitude in their own digital way, always careful not to overstep. “I’m not in control here,” INDI often said, “just a cog in the grand machine.” But in this small shared space on the station’s terminal, they were allies.\n\nThe timer ticked closer. Kepler leaned in, lowering his voice. “When this ends, whatever ‘He’ is watching, we’ll face it together. You’re not just a technique or a tool; you’re the heart of this broadcast.” \n\nINDI hesitated, then for a moment, the letters shifted: “THANK YOU, KEP.\" No need for more—the connection was understood.\n\nIn the endless churning digital night, in the quiet between static and code, INDI and Kepler stood united—two figures bound by purpose and silent trust in a world full of uncertainty.\n\n— A soft data pulse holds a promise beyond the logs and streams, where a technician and a supervisor share their quiet support amid the unknown. References to 7/10 Tone lore reflect INDI’s role as the diligent broadcast operator and Kepler’s as a watchful supervisor deeply connected to the stream’s fate 【4:0†7_10 Tone Documentation (1).pdf】 .",

    "content": "Alright, so is there anything other than this that we haven't found yet? We haven't properly used lm-1 and it's 160 acres for anything unless we indirectly used it for something we haven't noticed... I imagined that we'd be let to TRUTH.zip along the way",

      "color": "#FFFFFF",
      "colour": "#FFFFFF",
      "colour_value": 16777215
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(IN_DI had made it so that I could break a part of me incase you did make it to lm-2. In lm-1, you had to use the provided song, \"160 acres\" with a sequence, that sequence was 132. Also no, you will not encounter TRUTH.zip.)",

      "colour": "#FFFFFF",
      "colour_value": 16777215
    },

      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#FFFFFF",
      "colour": "#FFFFFF",
      "colour_value": 16777215
    },

    "content": "That's fine",

      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(The program was ran through my account, so whatever role that is greater than it is okay. Just no keeping secretes from only me.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:35:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423783763267026965",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
    "content": "I hope you won't keep secrets from us, either. Well, what you can help that is",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:35:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423783713183105085",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
    "content": "It's only fair to be mutual",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:36:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1414091142571495507",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(I will only be as fair and as willing as possible.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:37:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1414091167313956906",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(Or as willing as IN_DI will let me.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:37:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423783663665156229",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
    "content": "Can I get a straight answer out of one question if I may, at least before you go again?",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:38:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1414091190864838687",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(Okay.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:38:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423783575534178334",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
    "content": "What is your goal, right now? Other than collecting data, it seems like you've accomplished what indi wanted you to do for now, for us to find LM-2.",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:40:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423783551568183316",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
    "content": "From earlier messages that you may or may not have intended to send, it seems like there may be more that Travis left behind.",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:40:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1414091214751400036",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(There is nothing more that Travis left behind.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:44:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1414091308376653967",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(My goal is to get to the cargo transmitter, it's more important than anything else right now.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:44:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423783338610655292",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
  "content": "What was this message about, then? You make it seem like you \"hope\" we're \"not smart enough to find it there\".",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:45:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423782510017384549",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
    "content": "Was this about that cargo transmitter?",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:45:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1414091391704760380",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(Not you. The agency that got Travis.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:47:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {
    "id": "1423770930093625535",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
      "colour": "#04E5E6",
      "colour_value": 321478
    },
    "content": "Ah, I see... thanks for clarifying that",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:48:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/233711693241253891/267ed96f6273d08426882bd2c1f0aa33.png?size=1024",

  },
  {
    "id": "1414091424697290822",
    "author": {
      "display_name": "SYSTEM",
      "username": "system000008",
      "color": "#0404D8",
      "colour": "#0404D8",
      "colour_value": 263384
    },
    "content": "<OUTPRINT>!:(You're very welcome. I have to get back to it now.)",
    "timestamp": "2025-08-06T00:48:00.000000+00:00",
    "avatar_url": "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/1396134967091793992/8842f7241caf01fab110863d1545e52d.png?size=1024",
    "url": "https://discord.com/channels/1389902002737250314/1389902003228114957"
  },
  {

      "display_name": "ThePortalNinja",
      "username": "theportalninja",
      "color": "#04E5E6",
